query: Oh, I just have to say, the homemade lavender lemonade I picked up from the farmers market this morning was so refreshing, I’ve already finished half the pitcher and I’m already debating going back tomorrow to get more. My neighbor’s golden retriever puppy also stopped by my porch earlier, he’s still learning not to chew on doormats and it was honestly the cutest thing I’ve seen all week. Oh, and I finally got around to watching that new cozy mystery show everyone’s been talking about last night, the plot twist at the end of the first episode had me gasping out loud, I can’t wait to watch the next episode tonight. Anyway, I need to update the shipping address for my recent order, my user ID is noah_patel_6952, the new address is 517 Lakeview Drive, Suite 183, Seattle, WA 98195, USA.
